evals.prompt: I'm building a code review tool and I have an AI agent that runs linting checks. I want the agent to leave its findings as comments in Velt so reviewers can accept or reject them. The agent runs server-side in a Node.js cron job. Show me how to create the agent comment annotations via the Velt REST API, including the agent block with agentSource, agentId, and executionId. The agent is external (not a built-in Velt agent).
evals.expected_output: Should use POST /v2/commentannotations/add with type 'suggestion', commentData[0].agent block containing agentSource: 'external', agentName, agentId, executionId, and reason object. Should include x-velt-api-key and x-velt-auth-token headers.

assertions.name: uses-correct-endpoint
assertions.description: Uses the correct Add Comment Annotations endpoint

assertions.name: sets-type-suggestion
assertions.description: Sets annotation type to 'suggestion' for accept/reject UI

assertions.name: includes-reason-object
assertions.description: Includes reason object with finding details

assertions.name: includes-auth-headers
assertions.description: Uses x-velt-api-key header for REST authentication

assertions.name: agent-on-comment-data
assertions.description: Places agent block on commentData[0], not the annotation wrapper

evals.prompt: I already have agent comments in Velt from my accessibility bot. Now I need to: (1) read back all findings from a specific execution run using the REST API with agent filters, and (2) on the React frontend, handle when a reviewer accepts or rejects one of these agent suggestions. Show me both the REST query and the React event handling code.
evals.expected_output: REST: POST /v2/commentannotations/get with executionId filter. React: useCommentEventCallback('suggestionAccepted') and useCommentEventCallback('suggestionRejected') hooks with useEffect handlers.

assertions.name: uses-get-endpoint
assertions.description: Uses the correct Get Comment Annotations endpoint

assertions.name: uses-execution-id-filter
assertions.description: Filters by executionId for agent run-specific results

assertions.name: uses-comment-event-callback
assertions.description: Uses useCommentEventCallback hook (not a fabricated hook name)

evals.prompt: I want to build a custom React UI that shows agent suggestions with accept/reject buttons and a resolution banner after the user acts. I also need to query only pending (unaccepted) agent suggestions from the REST API. Show me how to use the VeltCommentDialogAgentSuggestion primitives for the UI and the correct REST filter for pending suggestions.
evals.expected_output: UI: VeltCommentDialogAgentSuggestionBody, VeltCommentDialogAgentSuggestionActions with Accept/Reject sub-components, VeltCommentDialogAgentSuggestionBanner for resolution state. REST: agentSuggestions: true filter on the Get endpoint.

assertions.name: uses-agent-suggestion-ui-components
assertions.description: Uses either standalone AgentSuggestion primitives or wireframe AgentSuggestion components for the UI

assertions.name: has-resolution-banner
assertions.description: Includes resolution banner for post-accept/reject state

assertions.name: uses-agent-suggestions-filter
assertions.description: Uses agentSuggestions: true filter for pending suggestions
